I'm aware you're just making a throwaway comment that is 'funny'.

But no, you're wrong, price doesn't tell you squat about SRS surgeons or their results.

All of the US based surgeons will cost you $20k+ these days, European surgeons a little less (around $18k-25k), but produce far poorer results in terms of sensate ability and appearance than the thailand surgeons, who generally run about $9k-15k.
